name: HTTP Request
description: Calls a web API and gives back the status, the body and fields picked out of a JSON answer.

inputs.name: url
inputs.description: https only; http works for this machine (localhost, 127.0.0.1, ::1). {secret:token_1} to {secret:token_3} fill a pack secret (Settings > Packs).

inputs.name: headers
inputs.description: One per line, as Name: value. A value may use {a} to {d}, and {secret:token_1} to {secret:token_3}: a key set under Settings > Packs, never saved in the workflow.

inputs.name: body_kind
inputs.description: text sends the body as it is; json reads it as JSON and fills the placeholders inside its strings.

inputs.name: body
inputs.description: The body. {a} to {d} are replaced by the inputs of those names. A secret cannot go in the body: use a header or the URL.

inputs.name: a
inputs.description: Fills {a} in the URL, headers and body.

inputs.name: audio
inputs.description: Sent as a multipart upload (when there is no picture).

inputs.name: video
inputs.description: Sent as a multipart upload (when there is no picture or audio).

inputs.name: upload_field
inputs.description: The form field the upload goes in. A JSON object body becomes the other form fields.

inputs.name: path1
inputs.description: A path such as data.items[0].name or items[-1].id. Fills field1.

inputs.name: fail_on_error_status
inputs.description: Make a status of 400 or more an error. Off: the status is only an output.
